summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 (event date September 10, 2026) disclosing the Fourth Amendment to its Senior Secured Credit Agreement with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent. The amendment extends the revolver availability period from October 2028 to September 2030, extends final maturity from October 2029 to September 2031, and voluntarily reduces the total facility from $1.05 billion to $975 million to lower borrowing costs and align with target leverage. The accordion permits increases to $1.4625 billion, and the minimum shareholders' equity test was reset. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
